scenes.caption: Perplexity Computer connects to 72 skills, plugin bundles, and live data feeds inside one 3D vintage card shop.
scenes.narration: Perplexity Computer connects to seventy-two specialized skills, plugins, and live data feeds, so we built a 3D card shop to explore them all.

scenes.caption: Step up to a brass and mahogany counter stocked with six collectible first-edition booster packs.
scenes.narration: Instead of scrolling through a flat settings list, you step up to a brass and mahogany counter stocked with six collectible first-edition booster packs.

scenes.caption: Slice across the top foil seam to peel back the wrapper in Three.js and fan out five holographic cards.
scenes.narration: When you slice across the top foil seam, the wrapper peels back in Three.js and fans out five holographic cards from the Wall Street and Alpha series.

scenes.caption: Custom GLSL diffraction shaders shift rainbow specular bands and cosmos starfields across the artwork as you tilt.
scenes.narration: Every card runs a custom GLSL diffraction shader that shifts rainbow specular bands and cosmos starfields across the artwork as you tilt your cursor.

scenes.caption: Click any card to open the 3D inspector with its exact load command, trigger phrases, and flagship prompt.
scenes.narration: Clicking any card opens the 3D inspector with its exact load command, trigger phrases, and a flagship prompt ready for Perplexity Computer.

scenes.caption: Flip the card to inspect its 1st-Edition astrolabe backplate, or click straight through to install on Perplexity.
scenes.narration: You can flip the card to inspect its first-edition astrolabe backplate, or click straight through to the live skill and connector pages on Perplexity.

scenes.caption: Pack 02 — Auteur & 3D Studio: Lemo-Opuscar code cinema, 5-minute science documentaries, and Brickify 3D LEGO.
scenes.narration: The Auteur and 3D Studio pack pulls Lemo-Opuscar code cinema, science documentaries, and the Brickify LEGO compiler.

scenes.caption: Pack 03 — Design Craft & Web Atelier: Website Building, Scroll-Story Landings, Taste-Skill, and Impeccable QA.
scenes.narration: The Design Craft pack pairs website building and scroll-story pages with Taste-Skill art direction and Impeccable QA.

scenes.caption: Pack 04 — Systems, Silicon & Red-Team: Security Audits, Graphify architecture maps, Datadog, and Advance-PR.
scenes.narration: For engineers, the Systems pack bundles security audits, Graphify knowledge graphs, Datadog telemetry, and autonomous PR shipping.

scenes.caption: Packs 05 & 06 — Deal Desk, Legal & Core Superpowers: Contract redlining, supplier risk scans, and live browser control.
scenes.narration: The Deal Desk and Core Superpowers packs cover contract redlining, supplier risk scans, and live browser control.

scenes.caption: Room 02 — Illuminated Glass Display Cases: Browse flagship cards shelf by shelf under warm tungsten cabinet lamps.
scenes.narration: Moving into the Illuminated Glass Display Cases lets you browse flagship cards shelf by shelf under warm tungsten cabinet lights.

scenes.caption: Filter display cabinets by foil tier to isolate Mythic plugin bundles or Gold connectors like FactSet and Daloopa.
scenes.narration: Filter the display cabinets by foil tier to isolate Mythic plugin bundles or Gold connectors from FactSet, Daloopa, and Carbon Arc.

scenes.caption: Room 03 — Complete 72-Card Collector Binder across global, organization, individual, and project scopes.
scenes.narration: The Collector Binder holds all seventy-two verified entries across every scope, with one-click JSON and CSV exports.

scenes.caption: Instant search and type filters narrow by trigger phrase, publisher, or capability type with direct Perplexity routing.
scenes.narration: Instant search and type filters let you narrow by trigger phrase, publisher, or capability type and jump directly to its install page.

scenes.caption: Room 04 — Loadout Deck Builder: Equip up to six cards or load curated presets like the Wall Street Deal Team.
scenes.narration: Finally, the Loadout Deck Builder lets you equip up to six cards at once, or load curated presets like the Wall Street Deal Team.

scenes.narration: It synthesizes a chained multi-skill master prompt ready to paste into Perplexity Computer. Explore the full 3D card shop and catalog now.
